description: Create a task under a project. Tasks group the subtasks that time is logged against. The task inherits its allowed billing types from the parent project. Discover ids with find_billing_work - never ask the user for an id.

create_general_activity.description: Optional. When true (the default for this tool), also create a default visible "General" activity under the task so time can be logged immediately. Set false to create a task with no activities yet.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

project_id.description: Id of the parent project (required). Must be a project in your organization.

name: create_task
